text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH GPU QUEUE — autoscaler failing to add nodes in eu-west-1-gpu-pool. Queue depth > 420. Paging on-call.
Maya S: I'm on it. seeing steady queue growth since ~2133309000.
Arturo G: logs show cluster-autoscaler attempted scale up but ASG failed to attach instance profile.
Priya N: @Maya S can you paste the CA logs?
Maya S: here: ```time="2026-03-15T09:12:34Z" level=error msg="ScaleUp: Failed to launch instance: CreateFleet error: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation"```
Dan K: that looks like an IAM/instance profile issue on the launch template change. We rolled a new LT last night for security tags, maybe the instance profile role lost iam:PassRole.
Maya S: kubectl logs cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system show: ```I0315 09:12:34.123456 1 scale_up.go:287] ScaleUp: Failed to create node: error creating launch template version: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole is required to create instances with the specified IAM instance profile```
Arturo G: Confirmed. ASG event: "Instance launch failed: instance profile not found or policy denies iam:PassRole".
Priya N: Customer impact? Are any requests 500ing or just queueing?
Maya S: Internal metrics: inference request latency degraded, some small customers hitting 503 on hosted API routes that require GPUs. Estimated 18 customers affected, high priority for those with Dedicated reservations.
Dan K: Triage plan: 1) Quick mitigation: manually scale with previous launch template (known-good) 2) Patch launch template IAM role to include iam:PassRole 3) Roll autoscaler policy once nodes join 4) Postmortem.
Arturo G: I'm preparing a manual scale command. Will use console to set ASG desired capacity +1 with LT version X.
Maya S: Command I'm running now (console step): ```aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name asg-eu-west1-gpu --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0abcd1234,Version=3 --min-size 2 --max-size 20 --desired-capacity 6```
infra-bot: Action logged: manual ASG update requested by Arturo G at 2026-03-15T09:18:02Z.
Arturo G: Doing the scale. watching node bootstrap logs.``
Maya S: New instance started but stuck in Pending -> FailedAttachProfile. CloudTrail shows "iam:PassRole denied for role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/redwood-gpu-node-role".
Dan K: I'll escalate to infra-iam to add iam:PassRole to node role or ensure LT references correct profile. @Priya N please notify support to flag impacted tenants and mark travel advisory.
Priya N: Notifying support + adding advisory: "Short GPU degradation in eu-west-1, routing fallback to CPU pool for non-GPU routes. Engineers working on autoscale. ETA 30m."
Maya S: Workaround applied: updated ASG to use LT version 2 (previous) and set desired capacity +2. New nodes booting and joining.
Arturo G: Nodes are joining now, kubelet registration seen: ```Normal RegisteredNode kubelet, node/gpu-node-az1 registered successfully```
Maya S: Also applied temporary toleration patch to gpu-pool taint to allow critical control-plane pods to run on CPU-fallback nodes while we stabilize.
Dan K: Confirming queue drain starting at 09:27Z. Tokenized request backlog dropping from 420 -> 80 in 7 minutes.
Priya N: Customer comms updated: "Issue partially mitigated, autoscaler failed due to IAM/launch-template mismatch. Manual rollback performed. Full remediation in progress, followup will include root cause and preventive controls." :thumbsup:
Arturo G: Next steps: 1) Fix LT to reference correct instance profile + iam:PassRole 2) Add unit test in release pipeline to prevent LT with missing iam perms 3) Add autoscaler alert on repeated CreateFleet/AccessDenied errors.
Maya S: I'll open an internal CR to lock LT changes behind pipeline gates.
Dan K: Logging for postmortem: CA attempts: ```2026-03-15T09:11:54Z ScaleUp: pods waiting for 6g.2026-03-15T09:12:34Z error: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole. retrying...```
infra-bot: ASG desired now 6 -> 8, instances healthy: 3/3 -> 6/6.
Maya S: All critical customers back to normal, latency trending down. We'll keep monitoring for 60m.
Priya N: Thanks all. I'll spin up incident page and schedule a follow-up postmortem.
Arturo G: Filing postmortem draft, will include timeline and LT change review.
Maya S: :tada: Great recovery. Adding retrospective action: restrict LT edits to infra-iam reviewers and add a pre-deploy sanity check for iam:PassRole.
Dan K: Closing pager. Reopen if regressions. :white_check_mark:
